en: Get your system built and running with an expert
zh: 和懂你行业的伙伴一起，把系统做出来、用起来

en: One consultant, an agent team, more projects
zh: 一位顾问带一支 Agent 团队，交付更多项目

en: NocoBase is the open-source platform for building, running, and evolving business systems with AI.Agents write the code and do the work, NocoBase provides the foundation and governance, and people make the decisions.
zh: NocoBase 是用 AI 持续开发和运行业务系统的开源平台。Agent 写代码、做执行，NocoBase 提供底座和治理能力，人来做决策。

en: Teams across industries build core business systems on NocoBase
zh: 全球各行业用 NocoBase 构建核心业务系统
客户故事 · 阳光电源

en: Running global operations on one NocoBase foundation
zh: 基于 NocoBase 构建支撑全球业务的数字化管理系统

en: How a global clean-energy leader builds and evolves dozens of core systems on a single shared platform.
zh: 作为全球新能源领军企业，阳光电源以一套统一底座支撑多个核心业务系统的快速交付与长期演进。

en: Building reliable business systems is still hard.
zh: 但构建可靠的业务系统依然不简单。

en: Your team is already developing with AI or vibe coding. Code gets written fast, but new problems come with it.
zh: 你的企业已经在用 AI 开发或者 Vibe Coding，代码写得很快，但新的问题随之出现。

en: Even with AI writing the code, permissions, workflow engines, and approvals are hard to design from scratch. They are full of edge cases and take a lot of work to maintain.
zh: 即使交给 AI，权限、工作流引擎、审批等底层模块从零开发，设计难度依然很高，边界情况多，维护工作量大。
架构随机漂移，逐渐失控

en: Switch developers, models, or even sessions, and the AI may improvise differently each time. The system gets harder and harder to maintain.
zh: 换人、换模型甚至换会话，AI 都可能随机发挥，系统越来越难维护。
并行任务很多，人确认不过来

en: You juggle several projects and tasks, switching between terminals and chats, while agents hand back more and more changes. There is more than anyone can review, but letting go feels too risky.
zh: 同时处理多个项目和任务，在多个终端和对话之间切换，Agent 交过来的改动也越来越多，人看不过来，又不敢放手。

en: Know-how is hard to capture and share
zh: 知识和经验难以沉淀和共享

en: Requirement context, business documents, and lessons learned are scattered across chat sessions on different computers. When people or agents change, they are hard to find.
zh: 需求背景、业务资料、项目经验散落在不同电脑的不同会话里，换人、换 Agent 就很难找到。

en: Let agents focus on your business logic.
zh: 让 Agent 专心写业务，

en: NocoBase Core is the open-source application foundation for business systems built and run with AI. Permissions, workflows, files, and other building blocks come ready to use, so agents build only what is specific to your business, all on one consistent architecture.
zh: NocoBase Core 是 AI 开发和运行业务系统的开源应用底座。权限、流程、文件等基础能力现成可用，Agent 在统一架构上只开发企业自己的业务。

en: Proven building blocks, ready to use
zh: 基础能力不用从头开发和验证

en: Core provides 20+ building blocks, including permissions, workflows, files, and notifications, so agents can focus on business logic.
zh: Core 提供权限、流程、文件、通知等 20 多项基础能力，Agent 只专注于业务开发。

en: One architecture, one set of standards
zh: 为 Agent 提供统一的架构和规范

en: Core provides project scaffolding, architecture standards, and development skills, so the architecture stays consistent and under control as people and models change.
zh: Core 提供项目脚手架、架构规范和开发技能，换人、换模型，项目架构都能保持统一、受控。

en: You own your apps and data
zh: 应用和数据归企业私有

en: Core is free and open source. Your business code and data stay in your own repositories and on your own servers, and you choose your own models and agents.
zh: Core 开源免费，业务代码和数据都在企业自己的仓库和服务器上，模型和 Agent 也由企业自由选择。

en: Let your team focus on decisions.

NocoBase Studio is the governance platform for teams building with agents. It brings your team’s Claude Code and Codex together into one agent team that moves tasks forward on its own. Progress is clear at a glance, and people make the key decisions.
zh: NocoBase Studio 是团队与 Agent 协同开发的治理平台。把团队的 Claude Code、Codex 组成一支 Agent 团队自动推进任务，进展一目了然，关键处由人做决策。

en: An agent team that keeps work moving
zh: 一支持续推进的 Agent 团队

en: Connect agents across many machines and schedule them centrally. They move many projects and tasks forward in parallel, around the clock.
zh: 接入多台机器上的 Agent 统一调度，24 小时同步推进多个项目和大量任务。

en: Project progress, task activity, agent workload, and model usage are all clearly visible.
zh: 项目进展、任务推进过程、Agent 工作负荷和模型用量都清晰可见。

en: When a decision needs a person, agents attach detailed reports, checklists, screenshots, and recommendations, so even business experts who don’t code can make the call.
zh: 需要人做决策时，Agent 会附上详细的报告、清单、截图和建议，不懂代码的业务专家也可以直接拍板。
方法、经验、知识沉淀在团队里

en: Skills hold how work gets done, the knowledge base holds business documents, and project memory holds what agents learn on their own. When people or agents change, the next one picks up where the last one left off.
zh: 技能保存做事的方法，知识库保存业务资料，项目记忆保存 Agent 自主学到的经验。换人、换 Agent 都能无障碍交接。

en: AI-driven, ready out of the box.
NocoBase Solution is a line of agent-driven business apps built on Core. Agents do most of the work, and people make only the key decisions.
zh: NocoBase Solution 是由 Agent 驱动的、基于 Core 构建的一系列企业业务应用，Agent 做大部分执行工作，人只做关键决策。

en: Each app comes with built-in business agents that follow your rules and proactively take on most of the work, such as checking refunds and handling tickets.
zh: 每个应用中内置很多业务 Agent，它们会按照规则主动承担大部分执行工作，比如核查退款、处理工单。

en: Agents show the evidence behind their work, and key decisions are always made by a person. Each agent inherits the permissions of the person it works for, so data stays secure.
zh: Agent 的工作成果会附上依据，关键决策必须由人来做。Agent 继承负责人的权限，保证数据安全。

en: Every app is built on NocoBase Core, with its consistent architecture and reliable foundation, so you can have a coding agent customize it.
zh: 基于 NocoBase Core 开发，具备统一的架构和可靠的底座，可以让 Coding Agent 对它们进行定制开发。

en: Free, open source, ready to use
Every Solution app is free and open source, runs on your own servers, and works with the model of your choice.
zh: 所有 Solution 均开源免费，部署在企业自己的服务器上，模型自由选择。

en: How is NocoBase different from vibe coding?
zh: NocoBase 和 Vibe Coding 有什么区别？

en: In both, AI writes the code. Vibe coding works well for quick prototypes and small tools. NocoBase is for business systems that have to run reliably for years and keep evolving.
zh: 二者都是由 AI 写代码。Vibe Coding 适合快速做出原型和开发小型工具，NocoBase 用来构建需要长期可靠运行、持续迭代的业务系统。

en: AI generates permissions, workflows, approvals, and other foundational modules from scratch for every project. That is costly, and hard to make reliable.
zh: 权限、工作流、审批等底层模块，每个项目都由 AI 从零生成，成本高且很难保证可靠。

en: Core provides ready-made building blocks, and agents build only the business logic.
zh: Core 提供现成的基础能力，Agent 只开发业务部分。

en: Switch models or sessions, and the AI may improvise. The architecture gradually drifts.
zh: 换模型、换会话，AI 都可能随机发挥，架构逐渐漂移。

en: Core provides one project structure and one set of development standards, so the system evolves steadily for years on a consistent architecture.
zh: Core 提供统一的项目结构和开发规范，系统在统一架构下长期稳定迭代。

en: AI changes often get accepted without anyone reading them, and problems pile up.
zh: AI 做了哪些修改，往往不看就接受，问题会越积越多。

en: Studio coordinates checks and reviews. When a decision is needed, agents attach reports, checklists, and screenshots, and a person decides.
zh: Studio 组织检查和评审；需要决策时，Agent 附上报告、清单、截图，由人来做决策。

en: Requirement context, project documents, and lessons learned are scattered across individual chat sessions.
zh: 需求背景、项目资料和经验散落在各自的会话里。

en: Studio captures methods and experience in skills, the knowledge base, and project memory, so a new person or agent can pick up where the last one left off.
zh: Studio 用技能、知识库和项目记忆沉淀方法和经验，换人、换 Agent 都能无障碍交接。

en: Your code and data belong to you.
zh: 代码和数据归企业所有。

en: Core and Solution are free and open source. Studio is available in the commercial editions.
zh: Core 和 Solution 开源免费；Studio 在商业版中提供。
在 GitHub 上查看源码

en: Core and every Solution app are free, open source, and ready for production.
zh: Core 和所有 Solution 开源免费，可以直接用于生产。

en: Core, Solution, and Studio all run on your own servers. Your code and data belong to you.
zh: Core、Solution 和 Studio 都部署在企业自己的服务器上，代码和数据归企业所有。

en: Your choice of models and agents
zh: 模型与 Agent 自由选择

en: No vendor lock-in. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other coding tools, and with a wide range of models.
zh: 不绑定厂商，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等编码工具和各类大模型。

en: Once released, your business apps run on their own. Day-to-day business requests never go through Studio.
zh: 业务应用发布后独立运行，日常业务请求不经过 Studio。
选择适合你们团队的起点。

en: Build your own system on Core
zh: 用 Core 开发自己的系统

en: Agents use Core’s ready-made building blocks and build only what is specific to your business.
zh: Agent 使用 Core 的现成能力，只开发企业自己的业务部分。

en: Use it as it is, or have a coding agent tailor it to your business.
zh: 可以直接安装使用，也可以让 Coding Agent 根据自己的业务需求定制。
带领 Agent 团队开发

en: Let your team focus on decisions. Leave the execution to agents.
zh: 让团队专心做决策，执行交给 Agent。

由 NocoBase 持续维护和升级

en: Agents handled 37 tasks today. You made just 6 calls.
zh: Agent 处理了 37 项日常工作，需要你拍板的只有 6 件。

en: Every saving comes with a paper trail.
zh: 省下的每一笔钱，都说得清来龙去脉。

en: Agents find, ship, and measure growth. You make the calls.
zh: Agent 找机会、做增长、看效果，你只管拍板。

en: Overnight tickets are handled by morning. Only 3 need you.
zh: 夜里进来的工单，早上已经处理完，只有 3 件等你拍板。

en: Agents drive the plan and flag delays before they land.
zh: 目标交给 Agent 拆解推进，延期风险提前冒出来。

en: Everything is ready the day before a new hire starts.
zh: 新人入职前一天，一切已经就绪。

en: Customer tiering is in production · roll back anytime
zh: 客户分级已进入生产 · 可回滚到上一版本

en: Agents write the code and do the work

zh: 3 个任务 · 35 项测试 · 3 轮代码评审

zh: NocoBase 提供底座和治理能力

en: {n} building blocks · one set of dev standards · tests, review, and sign-off
zh: 用到 {n} 项底座能力 · 统一开发规范 · 测试、评审、验收三道检查
数据表、字段、关联关系与迁移
上传、多端存储、在线预览与权限
账号体系、部门架构与成员管理

zh: 页面、操作与数据范围，人与 Agent 同一套
多阶段流转、条件分支与审批
模型接入、工具调用与 Agent 接口

收发邮件并自动关联业务记录
API、API Key 与外部数据库
页面布局、导航菜单与多语言
流程、审批与 Agent 运行都有记录
按合同额分 A/B/C，每月重算
